currentArchitecture.persistence: multi-run RunRepository with RunPackage v3 in IndexedDB; verified backup envelope; non-sensitive UI preferences in localStorage; legal profile session-only
currentArchitecture.telemetry: no remote telemetry; local privacy-preserving diagnostics only

experienceLens.invariant: The lens changes information density and explanation only, never source data, calculations, limits, or safety gates.
experienceLens.levelScaleDecision: A 1-10 scale is rejected until user research demonstrates ten distinguishable and useful states.

sessionOnly: imported legal profile without document payload

capabilities.evidence: React UI, canonical workbook snapshot, knowledge base, exports, tests and CI exist in this repository.
RunPackage schema v3, multi-run IndexedDB repository, automatic v1/v2 migration, SHA-256-verified JSON restore, CSV/XLSX/PDF exports and migration-safe validation are implemented and tested.

Immutable configuration snapshots, zones, plants, ScientificValue lineage, DomainEvent envelopes, formal task transitions, devices/calibrations, overrides and append-only audit events are implemented.
Users can create and switch isolated local runs through the RunRepository without overwriting historical snapshots.
Manual measured values are recorded separately from targets; canonical persistent alerts, acknowledgements and event history are implemented.
Web App Manifest and production service worker cache the application shell and canonical read-only datasets.
SHA-256-verified backup/restore plus CSV, XLSX, PDF and print outputs are available without a backend; corruption and v2 migration are tested.
Read-only provider contract, capability negotiation and trust assessment cover freshness, calibration, plausibility and conflicting measurements.
A local user-triggered diagnostic bundle exports app/storage/schema health and counts without measurements, notes, legal profiles or credentials.

capabilities.trigger: A named device protocol, trust boundary, offline behavior and calibration model are approved.
Authenticated collaboration or cross-device synchronization becomes a validated requirement.
Browser-side PDF/XLSX export fails documented fidelity or performance criteria.
SSR, authenticated server features, dynamic route handlers, database access or server-side jobs provide measured product value.
